title: Find and Replace in Files
description: Using sed to replace text across multiple files.
explanation_md: Combines `find` to locate files and `sed` to perform in-place string replacement.

title: Check if Command Exists
code:
if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Git is installed"
else
  echo "Git is missing"
fi
explanation_md: `command -v` is a portable way to check for the existence of a command in the user's PATH.

title: Loop Through Files
description: Performing an action on every file in a directory.
code:
for file in *.jpg; do
  mv "$file" "${file%.jpg}.png"
done
explanation_md: A `for` loop combined with parameter expansion to rename files.

title: Process List and Filter
explanation_md: Pipes the output of `ps` through `grep` to filter for a specific process, excluding the grep process itself.

title: Redirecting Output
explanation_md: `>` redirects stdout, and `2>&1` redirects stderr (file descriptor 2) to stdout (file descriptor 1).
